sql: SELECT 'col' AS k, table_name || '.' || column_name || ' ' || data_type || ' null=' || is_nullable AS txt FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND (table_name IN ('lead_insights') OR (table_name = 'ai_agent_usage' AND column_name IN ('company_id','kind','conversation_id','lead_id')) OR (table_name = 'wapi_conversations' AND column_name IN ('last_message_from_me','last_message_at','bot_enabled','ai_enabled','is_group','remote_jid','lead_id'))) UNION ALL SELECT 'waiting', c.name || ' | ' || count(*)::text || ' | oldest ' || min(w.last_message_at)::text FROM wapi_conversations w JOIN companies c ON c.id = w.company_id WHERE NOT coalesce(w.is_closed, false) AND w.last_message_from_me = false AND w.last_message_at < now() - interval '2 hours' AND w.last_message_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY c.name
